Methodology

How Northstar chooses, builds, and links calculator pages.

Every new calculator should have a distinct search intent, real inputs, a formula or verified lookup, visible assumptions, a worked example, and relevant internal links.

For safety-critical, financial, construction, fitment, towing, and electrical decisions, users should verify results with authoritative sources.
